---
title: "Manuscript display settings and panel exports"
output: html_document
---

This notebook applies the manuscript display conventions to the saved numerical inputs: palettes, module order, panel dimensions and selected vector plot checkpoints. It is a display/export stage, not a new statistical analysis. Source identities and hashes for vector checkpoints are recorded in `provenance/plot_checkpoints.json`.

Figure 1c uses the saved ATAC display matrix. The AC and ME3 signal panels use final module subsets with an explicit row-standardized display transformation. Exact final AC/ME3 heatmap scaling is not established by the archived inputs. Figure 6f and other input limitations remain identified in `DATA_AVAILABILITY.md`.

## Inputs and saved objects

Paths are relative to the `CortexCode/` directory. **saved-results** inputs support routine rendering; **optional-rerun** inputs are read only when the corresponding analysis is enabled. Wildcards identify file collections.

| Mode | Input path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig1_KC/*.csv` | Fig1_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig3_KC/*.csv` | Fig3_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig4_KC/*.csv` | Fig4_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig6_KC/*.csv` | Fig6_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Extended_Fig5_KC/*.csv` | Extended_Fig5_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Extended_Fig8_KC/*.csv` | Extended_Fig8_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `provenance/plot_checkpoints.json` | Exact saved PDF/PNG checkpoint paths and source identities |
| saved-results | `objects/plot_checkpoints/*` | Archived author vector/raster panel exports (not RDS) |

See [input locations](INPUTS.md), [saved R objects](SAVED_OBJECTS.md) and the [complete file inventory](config/file_inventory.csv) for original source names, sizes and availability. These large inputs are not part of the Git checkout.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/common.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(patchwork))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE)
```

## Original vector plot checkpoints

These are reused exports from the existing author scripts, with original source filenames and hashes recorded. Some labels predate Illustrator changes. The original AC heatmap alternative includes more modules than the final main figure; the assembled figure uses the final-module reconstruction below instead.

The original Extended Figure 8 Euler export retains its reported 823-interval intersection and 3,217 ME3-only plotting input. The actual side-specific unique ME3 overlap is 821, as recorded separately in the source table. Reusing this original schematic does not change that distinction.

```{r original-vector-plot-checkpoints-2}
assets <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(REPO, "provenance/plot_checkpoints.json"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(assets))) {
  dst <- file.path(REPO, "panels", assets$panel[i])
  dir.create(
    dirname(dst),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  stopifnot(
    file.copy(
      file.path(REPO, assets$pdf[i]),
      paste0(dst, ".pdf"),
      overwrite = TRUE
    ),
    file.copy(
      file.path(REPO, assets$png[i]),
      paste0(dst, ".png"),
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  )
  panel_registry[[assets$panel[i]]] <- data.frame(
    panel = assets$panel[i],
    note = assets$note[i],
    width = NA_real_,

    height = NA_real_
  )
}
jsonlite::write_json(
  MS, file.path(REPO, "provenance/manuscript_palettes.json"),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  pretty = TRUE
)
```

## Figure 1: aligned module panels

Counts, heatmap, proximal/distal fractions and median conservation share one module order. Final main-figure module subsets are A1–A17, Ac1–Ac15 and TMK1–TMK15. No values are pooled or reassigned to force an Illustrator label match.

```{r figure-1-aligned-module-panels-3}
for (prefix in c("c", "d", "e")) {
  med <- read_table("Fig1_KC", paste0(prefix, "2_Median_signal"))
  cnt <- read_table("Fig1_KC", paste0(prefix, "1_Module_counts"))
  ann <- read_table("Fig1_KC", paste0(prefix, "3_Module_summaries"))
  keys <- if (prefix == "c")
    paste0("A", 1:17) else if (prefix == "d")
    paste0("Ac", 1:15) else paste0("TMK", 1:15)
  med <- med[match(keys, med$Fine_clusters_short),
    ]
  cnt <- cnt[match(keys, cnt$Fine_clusters_short),
    ]
  ann <- ann[match(keys, ann$Fine_clusters_short),
    ]
  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(med$Fine_clusters_short),
    !anyNA(cnt$Peak_count)
  )
  m <- as.matrix(med[, vapply(med, is.numeric, logical(1))])
  rownames(m) <- keys
  z <- t(scale(t(m)))
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  if (prefix == "c") {
    dynamic <- read_table("Fig1_KC", "c2_dynamic_heatmap")
    constitutive <- read_table("Fig1_KC", "c2_constitutive_heatmap")
    original_display <- cbind(numeric_matrix(dynamic), numeric_matrix(constitutive))
    stopifnot(all(colnames(m) %in% rownames(original_display)))
    stopifnot(all(med$Fine_clusters %in% colnames(original_display)))
    z <- t(original_display[colnames(m), med$Fine_clusters, drop = FALSE])
    rownames(z) <- keys
    stopifnot(identical(dim(z), dim(m)), all(is.finite(z)))
  }
  h <- as.data.frame(as.table(z))
  names(h) <- c("Row", "Sample", "Z")
  h$Module <- factor(
    as.character(h$Row),
    levels = keys
  )
  h$Sample <- factor(h$Sample, levels = rev(colnames(z)))
  cnt$Module <- ann$Module <- factor(keys, levels = keys)
  p1 <- ggplot(cnt, aes(Module, Peak_count/1000)) +
    geom_col(fill = "black",
      width = 0.9) +
    labs(
      y = expression(10^3 * " pREs"),
      x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(0, 3, 0, 3),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
    )
  p2 <- ggplot(h, aes(Module, Sample, fill = Z)) +
    geom_raster() + scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = MS$inferno,
    limits = if (prefix == "c") c(-2, 2) else c(-4, 4),

    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
    labs(x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Z score") +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),

      legend.position = if (prefix == "e")
        "right" else "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 3, 0, 3)
    )
  a <- ann[, c("Module", "Proximal_percent", "Distal_percent")]
  a <- pivot_longer(
    a, c(Proximal_percent, Distal_percent),
    names_to = "Class",
    values_to = "Percent"
  )
  p3 <- ggplot(a, aes(Module, Percent, fill = Class)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Proximal_percent = "#00643B",
      Distal_percent = "#19AE69")) +
    labs(x = NULL,
      y = "%") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),

      plot.margin = margin(0, 3, 0, 3)
    )
  p4 <- ggplot(ann, aes(Module, Median_of_peak_mean_phastCons)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#993333",
      width = 0.9) +
    labs(x = NULL,
      y = "Median\nphastCons") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),

      plot.margin = margin(0, 3, 0, 3)
    )
  highlight <- which(keys %in% if (prefix == "c") c("A1", "A12") else if (prefix == "d") "Ac7" else "TMK3")
  display_labels <- setNames(sub("^TMK", "TM", keys), keys)
  highlight_layer <- lapply(highlight, function(position) {
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = position - 0.5,
      xmax = position + 0.5,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = NA,
      color = "#EE3890",
      linewidth = 0.45
    )
  })
  p1 <- p1 + highlight_layer
  p2 <- p2 + highlight_layer + scale_x_discrete(labels = display_labels)
  p3 <- p3 + highlight_layer
  p4 <- p4 + highlight_layer
  export_panel(
    p1/p2/p3/p4 + plot_layout(heights = c(0.6, 3, 0.6, 0.6)),
    paste0("Fig1/", prefix, "_manuscript_stack"),
    5, 6.5, note = "Final canonical module subset; inferno palette; saved ATAC display values, AC/ME3 row-z-score display approximation; verified counts/fractions/conservation"
  )
}
```

## Figure 4: stage-based median trajectories

```{r figure-4-stage-based-median-trajectories-5}
# Reproduce the final treemap partition and semantic colors from the
# verified counts.
d <- read_table("Fig4_KC", "4a_Interaction_counts")
counts <- setNames(d$Count, d$overlap_type)
n <- sum(counts)
left <- (counts["three_way"] + counts["atac_ac"])/n
right <- 1 - left
top <- (counts["atac_singleton"] + counts["ac_me3"])/n/right
mid <- (counts["ac_singleton"] + counts["atac_me3"])/n/right
z <- data.frame(
  Type = c(
    "three_way", "atac_ac", "atac_singleton", "ac_me3", "ac_singleton",
    "atac_me3", "me3_singleton"
  ),
  xmin = c(
    0, 0, left, left + right * counts["atac_singleton"]/(counts["atac_singleton"] +
      counts["ac_me3"]), left, left + right * counts["ac_singleton"]/(counts["ac_singleton"] +
      counts["atac_me3"]), left
  ),
  xmax = c(
    left, left, left + right * counts["atac_singleton"]/(counts["atac_singleton"] +
      counts["ac_me3"]), 1, left + right * counts["ac_singleton"]/(counts["ac_singleton"] +
      counts["atac_me3"]), 1, 1
  ),
  ymin = c(
    1 - counts["three_way"]/n/left, 0, 1 - top, 1 - top, 1 - top - mid,
    1 - top - mid, 0
  ),
  ymax = c(
    1, 1 - counts["three_way"]/n/left, 1, 1, 1 - top, 1 - top, 1 - top -
      mid
  )
)
z$Count <- counts[z$Type]
z$Label <- c(
  "3 way", "ATAC-\nH3K27ac", "ATAC\nsingleton", "H3K27ac-\nH3K27me3", "H3K27ac\nsingleton",
  "ATAC-\nH3K27me3", "H3K27me3\nsingleton"
)
z$Label <- paste0(
  z$Label, "\n", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * z$Count/n),
  "\n(", z$Count, ")"
)
cols <- c(
  three_way = "#CCCAC6",
  atac_ac = "#F48CA1",
  atac_singleton = "#FFB254",

  ac_me3 = "#92D4D5",
  ac_singleton = "#E85B70",
  atac_me3 = "#00ADC0",
  me3_singleton = "#ABD7A1"
)
p <- ggplot(z) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Type),

    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes((xmin + xmax)/2, (ymin + ymax)/2, label = Label),
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  coord_fixed(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Peak proximity interactions") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))
export_panel(p, "Fig4/4a_treemap_manuscript", 5, 6)
for (s in c("4b_A1", "4c_Ac7", "4d_TM3")) {
  d <- read_table("Fig4_KC", s)
  val <- grep(
    "^Median_", names(d),
    value = TRUE
  )
  d$Position <- seq_len(nrow(d))
  d$Cell_type <- ifelse(
    grepl("Vz", d$Sample, ignore.case = TRUE) &
      !grepl("Svz", d$Sample, ignore.case = TRUE),
    "VZ", ifelse(
      grepl("Svz", d$Sample, ignore.case = TRUE),
      "SVZ", ifelse(
        grepl("Nex", d$Sample, ignore.case = TRUE),
        "ImN", ifelse(
          grepl("Ntsr", d$Sample, ignore.case = TRUE),
          "L6N", "L5N"
        )
      )
    )
  )
  d$Sample_group <- sub("_[CR](_|$).*", "", d$Sample)
  d$Sample_group <- factor(d$Sample_group, levels = unique(d$Sample_group))
  d$Group_position <- as.numeric(d$Sample_group)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Group_position, .data[[val]], color = Cell_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = Sample_group),
      width = 0.55,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = 1),
      method = "loess",
      span = 0.8,
      se = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MS$cell) +
    labs(x = NULL,
      y = gsub("_", " ", val)) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

      legend.position = "none"
    )
  span <- diff(range(d[[val]], na.rm = TRUE))
  lower <- min(d[[val]], na.rm = TRUE) - 0.18 * span
  stage_strip <- unique(d[, c("Group_position", "Cell_type")])
  p <- p + geom_rect(
    data = stage_strip,
    aes(
      xmin = Group_position - 0.5,
      xmax = Group_position + 0.5,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = lower + 0.07 * span,
      fill = Cell_type
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = NA
  ) + scale_fill_manual(values = MS$cell) +
    labs(title = paste(sub(".*_", "", s), "trajectory")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15), legend.position = "none")
  export_panel(
    p, paste0("Fig4/", s, "_trajectory"),
    5, 2.5
  )
}
```

## Figure 6: manuscript box plots, GO and saved resampling violin

```{r figure-6-manuscript-box-plots-go-and-saved-resampling-violin-6}
for (s in c("6bprime_RPKM", "6o_RPKM")) {
  d <- read_table("Fig6_KC", s)
  for (g in unique(d$Gene)) for (ft in unique(d$FlashTag_population)) {
    z <- d[d$Gene == g & d$FlashTag_population == ft, ]
    if (!nrow(z))
      next
    p <- ggplot(
      z, aes(
        factor(Genotype, levels = c("WT", "Mut"), labels = c("WT", "cKO")),
        RPKM, color = Genotype
      )
    ) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,
        linewidth = 0.4,
        width = 0.65) +
      geom_point(aes(shape = Sex),
        position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1),

        size = 1.3
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = MS$rna) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(F = 16, M = 17)) +
      labs(title = g,
        subtitle = if (ft == "FlashTagPositive") "FTpos" else "FTneg",
        x = NULL,
        y = "RPKM") +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold.italic"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10))
    point_layer <- ggplot_build(p)$data[[2]]
    stopifnot(nrow(point_layer) == nrow(z), identical(sort(point_layer$y), sort(z$RPKM)))
    export_panel(
      p, paste0("Fig6/", s, "_", g, "_", ft),
      1.3, 1.65, note = "Reconstructed RPKM; WT blue/cKO red from manuscript"
    )
  }
}

d <- read_table("Fig6_KC", "6f_Gene_peak_counts")
d <- d %>%
  group_by(RNA_direction) %>%
  mutate(Plot_fraction = Gene_peak_overlap_count / sum(Gene_peak_overlap_count)) %>%
  ungroup()
d$RNA_direction <- factor(d$RNA_direction, levels = c("Downregulated", "Upregulated"))
p <- ggplot(d,
  aes(x = 2, y = Plot_fraction, fill = Peak_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
    color = "black",

  coord_polar(theta = "y") +

  labs(title = "Gene-peak overlaps", fill = NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(2, "mm")
  )

p <- p + geom_text(

  size = 2.8,
  fontface = "bold"
)
export_panel(
  p, "Fig6/6f_donut_recovered_analysis", 2.3, 3.6, note = "Manuscript magenta/grey; recovered original totals 484/250; final artwork 362/281 unresolved"
)
```
